strings.탐색마법으로 이리스 리비에르의 행방을 찾던 도중에 기묘한 움직임을 하나: While using search magic to trace Iris Livier's whereabouts, I detected an unusual movement.
I am bound to this world, so I must ask you to investigate.
strings.지금 우리가 있는 이 장소는 정상적인 시간의 흐름과 유리된 장소. 대개는: This place exists apart from the ordinary flow of time. It is usually filled with stillness and emptiness.
Those who walk the everyday world rarely visit here... Yet unexpected guests do sometimes appear.
A being wreathed in searing heat, bearing a power full of contradictions.
strings.실명한 몸으로 확신할 수는 없으나, 아마도 그 불꽃은 칠흙같은 색이었을: Blind as I am, I cannot be certain, but I believe its flames were pitch-black.
A strange fire, seemingly both corrupted and sacred.
strings....과거의 전투에서, 마침내 몰아넣었다고 생각했을때 불현듯 나타나 마왕: ...In a battle long ago, just when we thought we had finally cornered the Demon King, a bird of flame appeared. It merged with him and lent him its power.
I could not mistake that ominous flickering... It must be the same being.
strings.1. 불꽃의 새: 1. Ask about the bird of flame.
strings.지금 그것은 상처를 입은 것 같소. 피 대신 자신의 힘을 흩뿌리며, 이: It appears to be wounded now. I sensed it beating its wings through the emptiness of this vast world, scattering its own power in place of blood.
strings.그리고 갑자기 지워지듯 사라졌고, 그 자리에는 어느새 하나의 문이 생겨났: Then it vanished abruptly, as though erased. Where it had been, a doorway appeared.
Beyond it likely lies another world, one that has remained isolated until now...
strings.주의하시오. 저 편에서 배어나오는 것은 오직 죽음과 몰락... 어둠의 냄: Be careful. All that seeps from the other side is death and ruin... The scent of darkness.
strings.(사이암의 손에서 눈부신 빛이 뿜어져 나오기 시작한다.): (A dazzling light begins to pour from Siam's hand.)
I will open the gate through time and space. I hope you find a clue.
strings.(스토리가 생략되었습니다. 미지의 땅 바나헤임으로 이동합니다.): (The story has been skipped. Traveling to the unknown land of Vanaheim.)
strings.(사이암의 마법에 의해 도착한 곳은 기묘한 느낌이 드는 해안가이다.): (Siam's magic brings you to a strangely unsettling shore.)
strings.(쓸쓸해보이는 풍경이다. 어딘지 이질감이 든다...): (The landscape is desolate. Something about it feels alien...)
strings.(이상한 기분이 든다... 누군가의 인기척 같은게 느껴진다.): (A strange feeling comes over you... As though someone is nearby.)
strings.거기, 누구 있나요? 내 말이 들리시나요?: Hello? Is someone there? Can you hear me?
strings.아... 지금 혹시 대답하려 하신건가요?: Ah... Were you trying to reply?
strings.전언마법에 제대로 회답을 못하시는 것을 보니 무한회랑의 마법사는 아니시군: Since you cannot properly answer a communication spell, you must not be a mage of the Infinite Corridor.
Do you need help? I'm sorry, but I cannot come to your aid right now.
strings.지금 계신 장소에서 조금만 바다 반대편으로 이동하시면 거대한 탑이 있습니: Head a little farther inland, away from the sea, and you will find an enormous tower. The area in front of it is safe.
strings.길이 험하니 조심하세요. 실력에 자신이 없다면... 돌아갈 수단이 있으시: The road is dangerous, so be careful. If you aren't confident in your abilities... I pray you have a way to return.
As I said, to state the conclusion first: Lord Einst's intuition was correct.
Let me explain what our investigation has uncovered.
strings.아아... 그것은 아인스트님의 특별한 능력입니다. 폭풍의 감시자 중에서도: Ah... That is Lord Einst's special ability. I understand it is a power that awakens only rarely, even among the Storm Watchers. A unique perception that sees through to the truth of things.
strings.작게는 거짓말을 꿰뚫어본다거나, 원하는 미래를 성취하기 위한 올바른 과정: At its simplest, it can expose lies, or let its bearer instinctively grasp the right steps toward a desired future.
strings.제가 아는 것은 이정도이고, 자세한 것은 폭풍의 감시자들 사이의 비밀이라: That is the extent of my knowledge. The details are a secret among the Storm Watchers... Some say its abilities are even more extraordinary.
With the Belpa priestess's help, I deciphered documents found in the tower. The language has much in common with those of Jiendia.
I believe this land was once part of the continent of Jiendia.
It was described as a land where spirits lived alongside the children of the goddess.
strings.여신... 이라는 것은 아마도, 신들이 세계를 버리고 떠나던 시절, 오직: The goddess... That likely refers to the moon goddess. When the gods abandoned the world, she alone took pity on humanity, fought the Demon King, and perished.
Seres, Tyr, Arapea... There are various accounts of her name.
strings.이름에서 추측해볼때, 이 곳에 살던 민족의 이름은 '데르족'이 아닌가 합: Judging from the name, I suspect the people who lived here were the Tyr.
strings....일종의 거대한 아티팩트입니다. 정상적인 마법사라면 이런 것을 만들: ...is a kind of enormous artifact. No sane mage could build such a thing. No one should!
strings.(제이드는 굳은 표정으로 잠시 말을 멈추더니, 이내 한숨을 쉬며 미안한듯: (Jade falls silent, expression rigid. Then, with a sigh, Jade gives you an apologetic smile.)
I'm sorry. I got carried away. Let me continue.
strings.이건... 데르족에 대한 이야기가 전설대로라면 상상하기 힘들정도로 끔찍하: If the legends of the Tyr are true, this tower had a purpose more terrible and wicked than one can imagine.
strings.이 탑은, 일종의 '용광로' 라고 할 수 있습니다. 그리고 안에 들어가는: The tower is, in a sense, a furnace. And the material fed into it...
strings.이 탑이 작동하면, 이 안에 있는 모든 생명들은 그 육신을 잃고, 혼만이: When the tower is activated, every living being inside loses its body. Only the soul is extracted.
strings.거기에 저항하거나 버틸 힘이 없는 자들은 정신이 산산히 깨어져 죽고 말았: Anyone without the strength to resist or endure it would have died, their mind shattered.
How could anyone do something so horrific...?
...I cannot say for certain what they intended to do with that life force.
strings.다만, 이것이 \"마왕\"과 싸우기 위한 데르족의 마지막 카드가 아니었을: But I wonder whether this was the Tyr's last resort in their battle against the Demon King...
What in the world... did the Tyr do here?
strings.4. 어둠의 생물들과 소녀의 영혼: 4. Ask about the creatures of darkness and the girl's soul.
strings.이 탑의 마력에 의해 육신을 버린 데르족이 어떻게 되었는지는 현재로써는: What became of the Tyr who shed their bodies through this tower's magic remains a mystery. Their bodies, however, seem to have been left here.
strings.그것이 어둠의 생물들에 의해 침식당한 결과가 저 기이하고 끔찍한 생물들이: Perhaps those strange, horrifying creatures are what remained after beings of darkness consumed those bodies.
strings.밖에서 보셨다시피 이 지역은 지금 완전히 어둠에 오염되어 있습니다. 땅,: As you saw outside, this region is now utterly tainted by darkness. The earth, the water, the living things, even the wind... The Tyr bodies abandoned in this tower must have suffered the same fate.
strings.이 무서운 어둠의 힘의 주인은... 전설에 전해지는 마왕, \"비스트\": Could the master of this dreadful darkness be the Demon King of legend—Beast?
strings.즉, 데르족은 이곳에서 무언가 무서운 수단을 동원하여 마왕과 싸웠다. 그: In other words, the Tyr used some terrible means to fight the Demon King here. As a result, their people were destroyed, and this land was permanently corrupted...
strings.소녀의 \"부서진 혼\"은 그 과정에서 희생당한 혼의 파편이며, 그 눈이: The girl's shattered soul may be a fragment of one sacrificed in that process. Perhaps her eyes see the Demon King from her nightmares, rather than us...
...It is only conjecture, but I've made this a very grim tale indeed.
strings.5. 탑 최하층에 대해: 5. Ask about the bottom of the tower.
I sense the presence of an immensely powerful spirit on the tower's lowest floor.
strings.이런 거대한 탑을 마도기로 사용하는 것은 비상식적입니다. 전설에 전해지는: Using a tower this enormous as a magical device defies common sense. It would require a being like the legendary Pluton Dragon.
Perhaps a being with power to rival a Spirit King helped the Tyr. And it remains trapped beneath the tower even now.
strings.데르족을 도왔다면 그 본성은 악한 존재가 아니겠지만... 지금 이 밑에서: If it helped the Tyr, it cannot have been evil by nature... But what waits below has become a host to darkness, endlessly spreading the aura of death through the tower.
strings.희미하게 정령의 본성같은 것이 느껴지긴 하지만... 영고의 세월을 고통받: I can still faintly sense something of its nature as a spirit... But it must have suffered for an eternity. Defeating it would be a mercy.
strings.이 이야기는 제가 정리하여 아인스트님께 전하겠습니다. %s님. 당신께는: I will organize these findings and report them to Lord Einst. %s, there is an important mission I would like to entrust to you.
strings.(거대한 마법의 소용돌이가 눈 앞에 있다.): (An enormous magical vortex looms before you.)
strings.(주변을 휩쓸어버리기 충분할만큼 거대한 규모의 소용돌이가 이해할 수 없는: (Large enough to sweep away everything around it, the vortex circles silently in place amid an incomprehensible stillness.)
strings.소용돌이 주변을 떠도는 저것은... 설마 저 거대한 것이 마법 아티펙트일: That thing drifting around the vortex... Could something so enormous really be a magical artifact?
strings.(소용돌이 내부에 언뜻 그림자 같은 것이 보인 것 같다.): (For an instant, you think you see a shadow within the vortex.)
...Did you see that? There appears to be something inside.
strings.설마... 신화속의 존재들에게 농락당한 결과로 지금의 형태가 된 프레이오: Impossible... This is nothing like Freios, shaped by the whims of beings from myth. No artificial magic could suspend a structure that enormous...
strings....아니, 우문이군요. 지금 이 순간, 이 장소가 이미 신화의 영역인: ...No, what a foolish thing to say. Here and now, we are already in the realm of myth.
strings.(제이드의 표정은 말하는 것과는 달리 열기와 약간의 기쁨이 엿보인다.): (Despite those words, Jade's expression reveals excitement and a hint of delight.)
strings.문헌에는 <'위'로 올라가려면 탑의 정상으로 나가 빛의 계단을 밟으라>: The documents said, “To ascend above, go to the top of the tower and tread the stairs of light.”
I wondered what that meant. At least now we know where “above” is.
strings.계단쪽은 어렵지 않습니다. 이 주변의 마법진을 재구성해서 가동시키면 저: The stairs should pose no difficulty. If I reconstruct and activate the magic circles around here, we should be able to ascend to that place.
Please wait a moment. I'll restore the teleportation magic as quickly as I can.
strings.데르족이 왜 육신을 버리게 되었는가, 그들의 영혼은 어디로 갔는가, 정확: Why did the Tyr abandon their bodies? Where did their souls go? What exactly happened...?
...I hope the answers lie up there.
strings.(제이드에게 이 장소를 맡기고 우선 돌아가기로 했다.): (You leave this place in Jade's hands and decide to return for now.)
strings.(마지막으로 바라본 하늘에서, 공기중으로 투명하게 녹아들어가는 깃털 같은: (With one last glance at the sky, you think you see something like a feather dissolving into the air.)
